items.summary: fix(telegram): inherit root group policy across accounts Use channels.telegram.groups as the shared default when an account omits groups. Explicit account maps, including {}, remain full replacements. This keeps chat admission and sender restrictions on one policy path and fixes silent multi-account authorization failures. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
